name: easy-space-root
description: EasySpace - AI-Powered Diagnostic & Adaptive Video Learning Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client/dist')){fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});}"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
